title: Random Voronoi Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.33875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nearest-neighbor methods are local, simple, and interpretable, but their non-parametric form makes them memory-intensive, expensive at inference, and difficult to integrate into differentiable neural architectures. We introduce Random Voronoi Networks (RVNs), a family of structured three-layer MLPs that express nearest-neighbor geometry through sampled Voronoi comparisons. The first layer computes Random Voronoi Features (RVF) from affine pairwise separators between selected training samples, the second layer aggregates these comparisons into Voronoi cells or top-k neighborhood scores, and the readout layer produces classification or regression predictions. We show that, when all samples and pairwise comparisons are included, step RVNs recover exact Euclidean k-NN, while ReLU RVNs provide a violation-score realization for 1-NN that can be relaxed into a differentiable soft weighting. translated_abstract: 最近邻方法具有局部性、简单性和可解释性等优点，但其非参数形式导致内存占用大、推理成本高，且难以集成到可微神经网络架构中。我们提出了随机Voronoi网络（RVNs），这是一族结构化的三层多层感知机（MLP），通过采样的Voronoi比较来表达最近邻几何。第一层从所选训练样本之间的仿射成对分隔器计算随机Voronoi特征（RVF）；第二层将这些比较聚合为Voronoi单元或top-k邻域分数；读出层则产生分类或回归预测。我们证明，当包含所有样本及成对比较时，采用阶跃激活的RVN能够精确恢复欧氏k-NN，而采用ReLU激活的RVN为1-NN提供了一种违规分数的实现方式，并可松弛为可微的软加权。通过子采样可以得到具有显式……的近似RVN。
tldr: 随机Voronoi网络是一族结构化的三层MLP，通过采样的Voronoi比较实现最近邻几何的精确或近似表达，并可松弛为可微的软加权，从而将最近邻方法融入可微神经架构。
en_tdlr: Random Voronoi Networks are structured three-layer MLPs that express nearest-neighbor geometry via sampled Voronoi comparisons, exactly recovering Euclidean k-NN in the full-sample case and enabling differentiable soft relaxations for integration into neural architectures.
